subject: reading
title: Gran's Cake
about: June bakes a cake that tips off the plate, and Gran shows her how to fix it. Practises magic e in a_e (bake, cake, plate), u_e (June, cubes, tune), o_e (home) and i_e (fine), ee (sweet) and the -es ending (mixes), plus the tricky words she, we, they, so, of, is and says. Decodable at CKLA Unit 2, so he can read it alone.
tip: Cold read first, then read it to him, then let him read it again; ask what he would do with a cake that fell off the plate.

passage.text:
June is at Gran's home.
Gran naps.
June will bake a cake.
She mixes eggs and milk.
She adds a bit of jam.
Mom helps with the hot oven.
The cake bakes.
It smells so sweet!

Then the cake tips off the plate.
Splat!
June is sad.

Gran wakes up.
"We can fix it," she says.
They cut the cake in cubes.
"It is still a fine cake!" says Gran.
June grins and hums a tune.

cards.note: June bakes the cake while Gran naps.
The first line says June is at Gran's home.
The cake tips off the plate with a splat.

cards.q: What does Gran do to fix the cake?
cards.note: Gran and June cut the cake in cubes.
First she mixes eggs and milk, then adds jam.
The last line is June grins and hums a tune.

cards.q: How does June feel when the cake tips off the plate?
cards.note: The story says June is sad.
The cake tips off the plate and splats.
A cube is a block with six square sides, like dice.

cards.q: Which word is in the story?
cards.note: Cake is in the story; cape and came are look-alikes that are not.
